operations.name: path.add_anchor
operations.description: Insert an anchor on a path segment. subpath_index and anchor_index identify the segment starting anchor; x/y are the click point in document coordinates.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.bend_segment
operations.description: Bend a path segment by moving its two neighboring handles. Endpoints stay fixed; t is the segment parameter and is clamped away from endpoints.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

dx.description: Document-space x delta for the grabbed curve point

dy.description: Document-space y delta for the grabbed curve point

operations.name: path.combine
operations.description: Combine components of a path or active shape path: unite, subtract front, intersect, or exclude. Curves are flattened then raster-traced back to paths at document resolution.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; defaults to active path or active shape path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.connect_subpaths
operations.description: Connect two open subpaths. The from subpath continues from its last anchor; the target subpath is reversed first when to_endpoint is "last".

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

to_endpoint.description: Endpoint clicked on the target subpath

operations.name: path.convert_anchor
operations.description: Convert an anchor between corner and smooth. Optional handle_x/handle_y converts to a smooth anchor with handles through that document point.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

handle_x.description: Optional document x coordinate for smooth handle drag

handle_y.description: Optional document y coordinate for smooth handle drag

operations.name: path.create
operations.description: Create a new named path, or set the Work Path when work=true. data is {subpaths:[{closed,anchors:[{x,y,kind,in,out}]}]}; handles are absolute doc coordinates.

name.description: Named path label; ignored for work=true

work.description: Create/replace the Work Path instead of a named path

operations.name: path.delete
operations.description: Delete a named path or clear the Work Path. Defaults to the active path.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.delete_anchor
operations.description: Delete an anchor from a path by zero-based subpath_index and anchor_index.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.duplicate
operations.description: Duplicate a named path or Work Path as a named path. The copy becomes active.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named source path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.fill
operations.description: Fill a closed path on the active raster layer with color [r,g,b] or foreground. Respects the current selection by intersecting the path mask with it.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; defaults to active path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.from_selection
operations.description: Trace the current selection contours into the Work Path, or into a named path when name is provided. tolerance simplifies contour vertices in px.

name.description: Optional named path destination; omitted writes Work Path

operations.name: path.list
operations.description: List Work Path and named paths. Set include_data=true to return declarative subpath/anchor data.

operations.name: path.nudge_anchors
operations.description: Move one or more anchors on a path by dx/dy document pixels as one undoable edit. anchors is an array of {subpath_index, anchor_index}.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.rename
operations.description: Rename a named path. Work Path cannot be renamed; use path.duplicate or the Paths panel Save Work Path flow.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; defaults to active path

operations.name: path.reverse_subpath
operations.description: Reverse one subpath, swapping in/out handles so the same geometry can be continued from its former first anchor.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.set_data
operations.description: Replace a path with declarative data. Defaults to the active path, or Work Path when no active path exists. data is {subpaths:[{closed,anchors:[{x,y,kind,in,out}]}]}.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; "work" targets Work Path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

operations.name: path.stroke
operations.description: Stroke a path on the active raster layer using current brush defaults unless size/color/opacity/hardness are provided. Open and closed subpaths are stroked.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; defaults to active path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

size.description: Stroke width / brush diameter px (default current brush size)

pencil.description: Use hard binary edge like Pencil

operations.name: path.to_selection
operations.description: Convert a path to the current selection. Closed subpaths fill by even-odd rule. mode is replace/add/subtract/intersect; feather is px; anti_alias defaults true.

path_id.description: Path id from path.list; defaults to active path

name.description: Named path label instead of path_id

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection
